framework_lessons: Separate custody from the underlying protocol.
Evaluate per-share growth and policy channels.
assessment: Gold records and the local inflation turning point are confirmed. Brazil and China diverged, so emerging markets cannot be scored as one call. The report corrects Ethereum withdrawal timing. Terra discussion contains a serious fragility blind spot alongside explicit warnings and tiny research-only holdings. Cigna operating progress is separate from its five-year investment outcome.
verification_limitations: Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
